name: Slonks Pixel Canvas
description: An optional paint layer whose pixels and animation frames are composited over generated Slonks.
about:
## Role in the Slonks system

This contract stores a per-token paint layer for Slonks. Token owners or approved operators can paint or clear individual pixels and animation frames; the **SlonksRenderer** (`0x726383bd28fa1f95a7e3d300babf08f6444d0437`) reads this layer and composites it over the model-generated image when serving the **Slonks** NFT (`0x832233ddb7bcffd0ed53127dd6be3f1aa5845108`).

Painting or repainting a pixel burns 1 $SLOP and one Qualia token matching the chosen RGB color. Clearing a pixel burns 1 $SLOP, and duplicating a frame burns 100 $SLOP.
risks: Pixel edits irreversibly burn $SLOP and, when painting, a Qualia color token; frame duplication burns 100 $SLOP
The owner can replace the renderer used to calculate Qualia harvested when a donor Slonk is merged

paintPixel.title: Paint Pixel
paintPixel.description: Paint a single pixel of your token with an RGB color.
paintPixel.warning: Burns 1 $SLOP and one Qualia token matching the selected RGB color.

clearPixel.title: Clear Pixel
clearPixel.description: Remove the paint from a single pixel of your token.
clearPixel.warning: Burns 1 $SLOP. The previously burned Qualia color token is not returned.

paintFramePixel.title: Paint Frame Pixel
paintFramePixel.description: Paint a single pixel on a specific animation frame of your token.
paintFramePixel.warning: Burns 1 $SLOP and one Qualia token matching the selected RGB color.

duplicateFrame.title: Duplicate Frame
duplicateFrame.description: Copy an existing animation frame into a new frame on your token.

paintedPixelCount.title: Painted Pixel Count
paintedPixelCount.description: How many pixels are currently painted on a token.

frameCount.title: Frame Count
frameCount.description: How many animation frames a token currently has.

paintedPixel.title: Painted Pixel
paintedPixel.description: Whether a given pixel is painted and, if so, its color.

setRenderer.title: Set Renderer
setRenderer.description: Set the renderer used to calculate Qualia harvested after merges. Only the owner can call this.

transferOwnership.title: Transfer Ownership
transferOwnership.description: Transfer ownership of the paint-layer contract. Only the owner can call this.
